name: Haus Lechner
beschreibung: Haus Lechner is a traditional inn in the quiet municipality of Thiersee, nestled in the mountain world of the Tiroler Unterland. The rooms are functionally furnished and equipped with bathroom, WC, and some with a balcony. In the dining room, regional Tiroler dishes and drinks are served. The surrounding area invites activities such as hiking, cycling, and swimming in the nearby Thiersee. The atmosphere of the house is down-to-earth and characterized by family hospitality.
